label: Unaware
why: They do not know they have a problem. A benefit means nothing yet. Open with a moment they recognize.

label: Problem aware
why: They feel it and have not named a fix. Name the pain better than they can, then raise the cost of leaving it alone.

label: Solution aware
why: They are comparing categories of fix. Win on why your method beats the other methods, not on the pain.

label: Product aware
why: They know the product exists and are weighing it. Benefit plus proof up top, worries handled fast.

label: Most aware
why: They are ready. Extra persuasion adds friction. Price, terms, urgency, done.

label: Problem Agitate Solution
note: Strongest when the pain is already felt.

label: Attention Interest Desire Action
note: Strongest when they already know the product exists.

label: Old way against new way
note: Strongest in a crowded category where they are shopping methods.

label: Before After Bridge
note: Strongest when the sale is a transformation.

label: Story led
note: Strongest when they do not yet know a problem exists.

label: Offer led
note: Strongest for the ready to buy. Keep it short.

job: Name the pain in their words. No product yet.
Show the cost of leaving it alone. Make the stakes concrete.
Introduce the product as the release. Lead claim goes here.
Make the mechanism believable in three steps or fewer.
The single benefit, stated as a claim they can picture.
Widen the benefit. What changes in their day.
Proof plus specifics. Make wanting it feel safe.
Short mechanism so the benefit holds up.
Retire the alternative without naming a brand.
Name your method. One sentence a reader could repeat.
The mechanism. This is the whole argument, so give it room.
A table or split that makes the gap obvious.
Their world today, in detail, without judgment.
Their world with it. Sensory, specific, not adjectives.
The product as the crossing. Lead claim goes here.
Make the crossing believable.
A moment or a fact that stops them. No pitch.
Turn the moment into a problem they now recognize.
Why it matters more than they assumed.
First mention of the product. Lead claim goes here.
What they get and what it costs. Nothing else.
One real reason to act today.

label: Buy now
job: Restate the benefit and the guarantee. One button.

label: Capture email
job: One field and one reason to hand it over.

label: Book a call
job: Show what happens on the call so booking feels small.

label: Request a quote
job: Say what you need from them and how fast you reply.
Evidence a skeptic would accept. Numbers, names, or a demonstration.
What they get, what it costs, what happens next.
On the record without stealing a section.
Answer it before they scroll past.
Sits after the price so the worry never leaves the page.

value: price, risk, money, guarantee, refund, shipping, warranty
